picks.summary: Above the Warwickshire village of Long Compton stands one of England's strangest prehistoric landscapes. Her research focuses on legend and belief, cryptids, digital culture, and the ways that folklore develops and spreads through communities. Dr. McNeill discusses what folklore actually is, why folklorists study it, and what traditional stories tell us about the world around us.
